source.feature: SP01 ExplorationArea_2km polygon; published 2 km astronaut EVA exploration radius
source.terrain: NASA GSFC PGDA LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ, clipped 20 m LOLA DEM

definitions.operational_zone: Published SP01 2 km exploration polygon (not the full Slater Plain boundary).
definitions.adjacent_reference: Annulus 2–4 km from the published SP01 point, outside the operational polygon by construction.
definitions.slope_cutoffs: Descriptive fractions from 20 m DEM-derived slope; not the paper's exact buffered HLS suitability mask.

published_hls_suitability.interpretation: Published area satisfying HLS landing-slope and 100 m buffer criteria; positive raster cells denote included suitable area, zero cells are outside the suitable area.

limitations: The published polygon is the 2 km walking/EVA exploration buffer around SP01, not a mapped geologic boundary of Slater Plain.
The 2–4 km annulus is a project-defined local reference, not an official NASA or USGS region.
LOLA 20 m posting includes interpolation and cannot resolve all small craters or boulders; the 5 m LOLA mosaic and NAC imagery are needed for finer hazards.
This local Moon-to-Moon contrast does not change the cross-planet score rankings, which require matched Earth data and scale.
